mapper.sql: id, parent_id, code, name, name_en, description, status, sort_index, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ainer_dictionary_type WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{parentId})
SELECT FROM ainer_dictionary_type WHERE (parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{parentId}) ORDER BY sort_index, code
SELECT FROM ainer_dictionary_type WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort_index, code
SELECT FROM ainer_dictionary_type ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_dictionary_type SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), name_en = COALESCE(#{nameEn}, name_en), description = COALESCE(#{description}, description), sort_index = COALESCE(#{sortIndex}, sort_index), version = #{newVersion}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
